digest.component_or_area: link command and caused_by relation validation
propositions: caused_by links currently accept any target without verifying the target has a referencing commit, enabling misattribution
the referencing-commit validation logic exists in close_precheck but is private and not reused by link_core
a caused_by link should be refused if its resolved target has zero referencing commits, unless force is provided
the refusal rule must apply identically across library, CLI, and MCP interfaces by way of a shared predicate
a commit-less code repository should allow the link (unverifiable is not invalid), whereas a commit-less target should refuse it
the --force escape hatch must be spelled claim-style and documented in SKILL.md with a scope-of-work attribution example
